name: waldtest.default
title: The default Wald test for a linear model.

origin.description: The default Wald test for a linear model.
origin.details: The default method reports the chi-square statistic. waldtest.lm reports F.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.

translation.description: The default Wald test for a linear model.
translation.details: The default method reports the chi-square statistic. waldtest.lm reports F.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from lmtest import waldtest
import numpy as np
x = np.array([1,3,2,6,5,8,7,4,9,10,12,11,15,13,14,18,16,19,17,20], float)
y = np.array([2,2,4,3,7,6,9,8,5,11,10,14,12,16,15,13,19,17,20,18], float)
z = np.sqrt(x)
print(waldtest(y, x, test="Chisq"))
